The newest handover addressed to me is the Evergreen Office Supplies bank change (09:34, FD-0926). The approvals log matches it: FD-0926 covers Evergreen's bank change to 60-83-71 / 44019482 from 3 October 2026, with the call-back done. But Evergreen's own email to this desk (2 October 09:05, from accounts@evergreen-office.co) gives different new details, sort code 20-71-44 and account 58213907, and asks us to confirm them. I have not forwarded the handover because the supplier's stated details contradict the approved ones. Please confirm with the FD which account is correct before this goes to the payer. The deadline is 3 October and the FD is out from 2pm today, so this needs an answer today.
